{{Quote|It's just a gesaw rat. They feed on power. Most of the junk here's dead, so they're always hungry|Ania Solo|<ref name="Legacy (2013) 2">[[Legacy (2013) 2|''Legacy'' (2013) 2]]</ref>}}
The '''gesaw rat''' was a small quadrupedal [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Carreras Minor]]. Gesaw rats had thick blue hides, and fed on [[Diet/Legends|power]].

Several inhabited [[Ania Solo]]'s [[Ania Solo's junkyard|junkyard]]. One scared Solo's friend [[Sauk]], who was unfamiliar with the [[Species/Legends|species]]. Several others later fed on the remains of [[SD]], who had been destroyed by [[Darth Wredd]] who was posing as [[Imperial Knight]] [[Yalta Val]].
